checks.detail: T12 TaskSpec envelope binds exactly three owned files (campaign_controller.py, test_control_plane_campaign_controller.py, test_control_plane_campaign_two_cycle.py) plus six t12 evidence files, forbids every other campaign/control-plane module, data/KBase, scheduler/ACL, user files, strategy, requirements, policies and inventories; dependencies name T7/T10/T11; payload_sha256 matches canonical serialization.

All twenty-six input evidence references hash-match the live repository: P6 approval, scope manifest, baseline, T1 validation, T1-T11 task reports, and T1-T11 completions; baseline_sha256 matches implementation_baseline.json.

The only tracked source changes are campaign_controller.py plus the two owned test modules; data, KBase, strategy, policy, scheduler/ACL, user files, and all other control-plane modules are untouched.

OperationalCampaignController now exposes execution_mode and namespace from its journal, and require_formal_learning_sink delegates to the journal's fail-closed dry-run guard; dry-run namespaces stay separate from formal namespaces and dry-run budget reservations never alias the formal budget; commit_learning on a dry-run journal raises DryRunIsolationError before any formal Learning artifact is written.

p7_authorized=false, campaign_authorized=false, final_holdout_authorized=false, auto_advance=false; no real data/KBase read or update, no scheduler/ACL mutation, no daily update/backtest/research/campaign/holdout started; all dry-run cycles use fake providers in isolated temporary journals.

advisories.detail: T12 composes the existing dry-run namespace/budget/learning-sink primitives at the controller layer; it does not add a separate dry-run CLI surface, which belongs to later composition slices if the plan requires it.
Dry-run model execution still uses the same fake provider injection path as formal cycles; a distinct preview-only provider policy is not required by the P6 scope.
